english: Let $t_0$ be the real number for which $D(t_0)=27$. Then the value of $t_0$ is ______.
hindi: वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए माना कि
है। माना कि $t_0$ वह वास्तविक संख्या है जिसके लिए $D(t_0)=27$ है। तब $t_0$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $(i+jt)^{2}=1\cdot j^{2}t^{2}+i\cdot 2jt+i^{2}\cdot1$, so $D(t)$ is the row-by-column product of
solution_full: So the matrix of $D(t)$ is $AB$, where $A$ has rows $(1,i,i^{2})$ for $i=1,2,3$ and $B$ has rows $(t^{2},4t^{2},9t^{2})$, $(2t,4t,6t)$, $(1,1,1)$. By the multiplication theorem $D(t)=\det A\cdot\det B$.
In $\det B$ take $t^{2}$ out of the first row and $2t$ out of the second: $\det B=2t^{3}\begin{vmatrix}1&4&9\\1&2&3\\1&1&1\end{vmatrix}$.
Hence $D(t)=-8t^{3}$ for all $t$ (check: $D(1)$ has rows $(4,9,16),(9,16,25),(16,25,36)$ with determinant $-8$).
originality_note: New: a determinant of squares (i + jt)^2 that factors, by the multiplication theorem, into a Vandermonde determinant times a scaled one, giving the clean form -8t^3 (way 4: hidden product structure). Closest known: det of (a_i + b_j)^2 style matrices and the power-sum determinant equal to a squared Vandermonde. Different because: the parameter enters every entry, and the student must split each square into three rank-one terms and extract t^3.

concept_use.Multiplication of Determinants: The matrix of D(t) is the product AB of a Vandermonde matrix and a parameter matrix, so D = det A det B.
concept_use.Application of properties of determinant: Factors t^2 and 2t come out of rows of B, and det A is evaluated as a Vandermonde product; these properties give -8t^3.

stem_review: Read as a student: t real; D(t) written in full; D(t) = -8t^3, so D(t0) = 27 has exactly one real root and t0 is well defined. Checked with sympy. Answer -1.50, a negative decimal as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Write (i+jt)^2 as a sum of three products and use det(AB) = det A det B.
justification: Recognising a product of two determinants and two standard evaluations; routine chain. A student who expands directly also succeeds with effort. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q12 (L2).
